body_markdown:
The Frigade Assistant now has an MCP server. It allows you to connect Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT to your workspace and ask about your questions, answers, feedback, insights, and users in plain language. For instance, you can ask it to find all the feedback pertaining to a certain topic or all the questions from a given user. It also allows you to easily set up and maintain the Assistant in your codebase.


To set it up, open Integrations in the dashboard and choose Frigade MCP Server. It shows the server URL for your region and the steps for each client.
